description: Creates a board on the person's Pinterest account. Give a name, or give image_urls of drafts and a name and description are suggested from them (the same suggestion as the "+ New board" button in URL2Pin). If a board with that name already exists, that board is returned and nothing new is made. The board is public unless secret is true. At most 3 per account per day through this server.

account_id.description: Which connected Pinterest account. Default: the most recently connected one.

image_urls.description: Drafts the board is for, used to suggest a name.

name.description: Board name. Leave out to have one suggested from image_urls.

secret.description: Make it a secret board. Default false.

name: create_board
title: Create a Pinterest board
